_comment: The single source of truth for what a release IS. Everything that states a
release fact -- the website, install.sh, the Sparkle appcast -- is checked
against this by scripts/check_release.py, and the site reads it at build time.
Binaries live in GitHub Releases on the PUBLIC Icarus-Website repo, because
this repo is private and a private repo's release assets require auth. They
are not in git history and are no longer served by the site: the site keeps
/Icarus.dmg as a redirect so every link already in the wild still resolves.
Prepare a new release through Gate 6 of docs/LAUNCH_CANARY.md; the checker is read-only.
